instance.finding_key: packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts::yorkiestore expands formulas with index-only bounds that ignore `batchoverlay`, so during a batch (e.g. paste) new cells outside the prior extent are neither summed nor registered as dependencies

finding.summary: YorkieStore expands formulas with index-only bounds that ignore `batchOverlay`, so during a batch (e.g. paste) new cells outside the prior extent are neither summed nor registered as dependencies
finding.evidence: yorkie-store.ts `buildDependantsMap`: `const bounds = this.cellIndex.bounds();` is computed once from the index, then used for both the document-cell loop *and* the `batchOverlay` loop, even though overlay cells are explicitly the ones not yet in the document/index. `getUsedBounds()` likewise returns `this.cellIndex.bounds()` with no overlay merge, and `calculate()` uses it to clamp the formula it evaluates. A batch that adds rows below the previous extent therefore yields both a wrong SUM(A:A) value and missing dependants for the new cells.
